plays.title: Break Down YouTube Gold
plays.description: Curate and comment on high-value long-form YouTube content like Sam Ovens to demonstrate sharp growth marketing insight and taste.
plays.action:
1. Watch or re-watch a 30+ minute high-signal YouTube video on growth or business (Sam Ovens style).
2. Extract a standout quote, metaphor or moment (e.g. the battery hen analogy).
3. Tweet the quote or insight + your reaction with emojis if it fits + an engagement question like "Anyone still watching this gold?".
4. Credit the source and briefly note why it's gold (e.g. emergence of Skool).
5. Engage replies by adding more context from your own YouTube/SEO experience.

plays.title: Test Next-Phase Parasite SEO
plays.description: Experiment with Instagram and Facebook as distribution channels and publicly discuss shifting SEO efforts for lighter moderation and reach.
plays.action:
1. Pick a growth marketing topic or keyword you want visibility for.
2. Create and post optimized short-form content (Reels, carousels, posts) on Instagram and/or Facebook.
3. Post your take on X: "Are we moving to the next phase of parasite SEO? Instagram and Facebook could well be the places to be putting your effort and you don't need to worry as much about moderation."
4. Follow up with results, comparisons to YouTube/Google, or examples.
5. Track performance over 1-2 weeks and report back in a follow-up post.

plays.title: Storytell with Real View Metrics
plays.description: Use concrete view counts and SEO results as social proof to support your positioning as a growth marketer seeking full-time roles.
plays.action:
1. When a video or SEO project reaches a meaningful milestone, capture the data or screenshot.
2. Post a clear update with the number + the tactic behind it.
3. Reference your track record naturally: "I have millions of views on YouTube and through SEO".
4. Use these updates when replying to growth marketing discussions or opportunities.
5. Keep your bio and any pinned content updated with the proof.

plays.title: Share Your AI Video Generation Flows
plays.description: Document and demonstrate your specific image-to-video creation process using tools like ElevenCreative to show practical, replicable AI skills for marketers.
plays.action:
1. Select or prepare a source image for your video.
2. Connect the source image using your @ElevenCreative flow.
3. Write a description for the video in seedance (or your video gen tool) and generate the clip.
4. Tweet something like: "not sure to be honest, I have an @ElevenCreative flow that I use, where you connect the source image and then describe the video in seedance here's another one!" + attach or link the result.
5. Reply to questions with extra details or prompt tips.
